text:
mira_cs: Heads up — VergeHealth renewal on Friday. Drafted the amendment but procurement says they might pay by card instead of submitting a PO, and they want a 9mo term instead of 12. This could impact revenue recognition and our standard PO workflow. Can legal/accounting weigh in?

jordan_am: Card vs PO is the usual snag. Finance prefers PO for anything >50k but exceptions happen with exec ok. How big is the amount?

mira_cs: Rough numbers: original 12mo $72,000 ARR, proposal is 9mo pro-rated ~$54k. They asked to split into 3 payments to push through CC.

beth_accounting: Policy: we don't accept CC for enterprise deals >100k normally. 54k could be exception territory but needs risk signoff and cc-auth form. Who's the PO contact?

jordan_am: Procurement contact is Lina Perez (lina.perez@vergehealth.com). They said PoS team is overloaded and CC would speed things up. They also requested DocuSign route for signatures.

esign-bot: DocuSign envelope created (env_0x9f7c). Status: created. Link: https://docusign.example/env/0x9f7c

li_ops: If we do CC, billing needs card capture + auth form. I can set up an invoice schedule: `3x installment, net30` and attach a CC authorization template.

sam_legal: We can allow CC with an addendum: include payment schedule, chargeback protection language, and a 30-day termination clause if payments fail. Need CFO approval for exception and a short risk memo. I can draft language today.

mira_cs: Perfect. Also the customer called out latency spikes on batch inference as a reason for trimming seats next quarter — let's capture that feedback in the amendment and offer a short performance plan (Dedicated trial).

li_ops: I'll add a paragraph to the SOW offering a 30-day Dedicated trial and include SLA metrics. Snippet: ```SLA: 99.5% p95 latency under baseline workload; remediation credit = 10% of monthly fee```

beth_accounting: For CC flow, accounting needs: 1) signed CC auth, 2) invoice schedule (3 dates), 3) PO waiver email thread or exec ok. Send to billing@redwood-inference.com.

jordan_am: I'll send the senario to Lina with the DocuSign link once legal posts the addendum. Plan: send EOD, ask for sign & card capture within 48h.

sam_legal: Drafted addendum and uploaded to DocuSign envelope env_0x9f7c. Added clause: `payment installments remain due regardless of usage; chargeback disputes escalate to legal`. Tagging @beth_accounting for review.

beth_accounting: Reviewing now. If all good I can approve the exception and mark the invoice terms.

mira_cs: Thanks everyone. Quick wins: 1) capture Lina's exec approval email for PO waiver, 2) get DocuSign signed and CC auth, 3) log the latency feedback in the customer health notes. Ping me for any blocker. :thumbsup:

jordan_am: Will do.

li_ops: I'll attach runbook and SLA snippet to the renewal package once accounting confirms.

esign-bot: DocuSign envelope env_0x9f7c status: sent to lina.perez@vergehealth.com at 2024-05-02T18:12:30Z

mira_cs: Closing loop — thanks team. If we get the signed doc + cc auth by Thursday, we keep the renewal on schedule.
